title: TrakHound Package Information
description: Describes a TrakHound Package (trakhound.package.json): its ID, category, version prefix, metadata and dependencies. See the Developer Guide, section 8.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file (for editors). Ignored by the CLI and the Instance.

id.description: The Package ID (ex. Contoso.Hello). The project's assembly must be named <id>.dll.

version.description: A two part version prefix (ex. "0.3"). The CLI adds the git height when it builds the Package (ex. 0.3.4). Required to build.

metadata.description: Information about the Package. Keys starting with '.' are read by the Instance. Your own keys are allowed.

description.description: What the Package does, shown with it on the Instance and Package Servers.

project.description: The project the Package belongs to.

repository.description: The source repository URL, so the Package can be traced to the commit it was built from.

repositoryDirectory.description: The Package's folder within its source repository (ex. modules/Contoso.Hello).

.defaultName.description: The name of a new Configuration.

.defaultRoute.description: Apis and Apps: the route of a new Configuration (ex. contoso/hello).

.defaultVolumeId.description: The Volume ID of a new Configuration (and of an existing one with an empty Volume ID when a version it runs is installed).

.configurationParameters.description: The Configuration Parameters the Package reads, comma separated (ex. "host,port,useSsl"), listed in the Admin interface's Configuration form.

id.description: The ID of the Package depended on.

version.description: An exact version (ex. "1.0.0") or a wildcard (ex. "1.*" matches any 1.x version).

minimumVersion.description: The lowest version that satisfies the dependency, used with a wildcard version (ex. "1.2.0" with "1.*").
